area.sourceLabel: Guelph Transit on-demand page and the City's on-demand bus stop layer
area.serviceHours: Monday to Saturday 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at select stops, connecting to the four transit hubs (Guelph Central Station, University Centre, Woodlawn Smart Centres and Gordon/Clair). Sunday 7:15 to 9 a.m. and 7:15 to 10 p.m. at all stops except those served by 98 Speedvale and 99 Mainline. Statutory holidays 9:15 a.m. to 6:45 p.m.
area.hoursNote: Statutory holidays: 9:15 a.m. to 6:45 p.m. Civic Holiday and Boxing Day run Sunday hours; Christmas Eve runs regular hours.
area.bookingInfo: Book in the Guelph Transit On-demand app, at book.ondemandyourway.com or call 519-822-1811. Last-minute rides are possible; booking seven days ahead is recommended.

notes: Stop-based service with no zone outline, so only stops are drawn. Stops are every point of the City's OpenData bus stop layer (OpenData1/FeatureServer/33, edited 2026-10-30) whose Monday-to-Saturday, Sunday or holiday on-demand flag is Yes; this layer is the one behind the 'On-Demand Bus Stop Locations' map linked from the page. Its 19 Monday-to-Saturday stops match the page's 'On-Demand Schedule Effective November 1, 2026' sheet (15 stops plus the four hub stops). Stops are grouped by which days they have on-demand service so each group carries its own hours: Monday to Sunday 15, Monday to Saturday only 4, Sunday 538, holidays only 2 (University Centre North Loop Platforms 10 and 11). Holiday hours are text only, since the hours rows have no holiday day. 92 stops with no on-demand flag (98 Speedvale and 99 Mainline stops) are left out. Monday to Saturday trips connect to the four hubs; on Sundays a transfer may be needed. That hub rule is in the hours text rather than a trip rule, because the same stops have no such limit on Sundays. Open to everyone at the regular fare; rides may be shared with Mobility Services customers.
